example.zh: 哦，原来你早就知道这件事了。
example.en: Oh, so you knew about this long ago.

example.zh: 嘿，你的钥匙掉在地上了！
example.en: Hey, your keys fell on the floor!

example.zh: 嗨，好久不见，你最近怎么样？
example.en: Hi, long time no see, how have you been?

嘛.gloss: particle stressing that something is obvious; particle softening a request or suggestion
嘛.indonesian: partikel penegas hal yang sudah jelas; partikel pelunak ajakan atau permintaan

example.zh: 这个问题很简单嘛，你再想想。
example.en: This question is simple, think about it again.

家伙.indonesian: orang; si dia (sebutan akrab atau kasar); benda

example.zh: 这个家伙每天都迟到，老板很不高兴。
example.en: This guy is late every day, and the boss is very unhappy.

啦.gloss: sentence-final particle (le + a); particle expressing excitement or a change of situation
啦.indonesian: partikel akhir kalimat (gabungan le + a); partikel seruan atau perubahan keadaan

example.zh: 太好啦，我们终于考完试了！
example.en: Great, we've finally finished our exams!

喂.gloss: hello (on the phone); hey; to feed

example.zh: 喂，请问是王老师吗？
example.en: Hello, is this Teacher Wang?

example.zh: 哇，这里的风景真是太美了！
example.en: Wow, the scenery here is really beautiful!

拜托.gloss: to ask a favour; please; I'm counting on you

example.zh: 这件事就拜托你了，谢谢！
example.en: I'm counting on you for this, thanks!

example.zh: 我只是随便问问而已，你别紧张。
example.en: I'm just asking casually, that's all. Don't be nervous.

example.zh: 王夫人每天早上都去公园散步。
example.en: Mrs. Wang takes a walk in the park every morning.

example.zh: 科学家在冰川里发现了一只古老动物的尸体。
example.en: Scientists discovered the body of an ancient animal in a glacier.

现场.gloss: scene (of an event); site; on the spot; live
现场.indonesian: lokasi kejadian; tempat acara; di tempat; langsung (siaran)

example.zh: 演唱会现场来了好几万名观众。
example.en: Tens of thousands of spectators came to the concert venue.

example.zh: 这座老监狱现在已经改成了博物馆。
example.en: This old prison has now been turned into a museum.

example.zh: 你刚才说啥？我没听清楚。
example.en: What did you just say? I didn't hear clearly.

example.zh: 这种植物缺水太久就会死亡。
example.en: This plant will die if it goes without water for too long.

拥有.gloss: to have; to possess; to own

example.zh: 他拥有一家很受欢迎的咖啡店。
example.en: He owns a very popular coffee shop.

example.zh: 小说的最后，读者才知道凶手是谁。
example.en: Only at the end of the novel do readers find out who the killer is.

example.zh: 他一屁股坐在沙发上，再也不想动了。
example.en: He plopped down on the sofa and didn't want to move again.

example.zh: 这次比赛一共有两百名选手参加。
example.en: A total of two hundred contestants took part in this competition.

example.zh: 全班同学投票选出了新的班长。
example.en: The whole class voted to choose a new class monitor.

撒谎.gloss: to lie; to tell a lie

example.zh: 孩子撒谎的时候，脸常常会红。
example.en: When children lie, their faces often turn red.

example.zh: 对他来说，幽默是解决矛盾最好的武器。
example.en: For him, humour is the best weapon for resolving conflicts.

发誓.gloss: to swear; to vow; to pledge

example.zh: 他发誓以后再也不熬夜玩游戏了。
example.en: He swore he would never stay up late playing games again.

example.zh: 他这个人心眼儿小，一点儿玩笑都开不起。
example.en: He is petty and can't take even a little joke.

意识.gloss: to realize; to be aware of; consciousness; awareness

example.zh: 他终于意识到自己的错误了。
example.en: He finally realized his mistake.

example.zh: 我在这些资料里找到了解决问题的线索。
example.en: I found a clue to solving the problem in these materials.

砸.gloss: to smash; to pound; to break; to fail (colloquial)

example.zh: 这次考试我考砸了，心情特别差。
example.en: I messed up this exam and I'm in a really bad mood.

example.zh: 那只失踪了三天的猫自己回家了。
example.en: The cat that had been missing for three days came home by itself.

example.zh: 时间会告诉我们事情的真相。
example.en: Time will tell us the truth of the matter.

example.zh: 我不敢一个人看恐怖电影。
example.en: I don't dare to watch horror films alone.

example.zh: 这位歌手的声音低沉又性感。
example.en: This singer's voice is deep and sexy.

意味着.gloss: to mean; to signify; to imply

example.zh: 放弃这次机会意味着还要再等一年。
example.en: Giving up this chance means waiting another year.

example.zh: 现在很多交易都可以在网上完成。
example.en: Nowadays many transactions can be completed online.

example.zh: 我晕车了，觉得有点儿恶心。
example.en: I'm carsick and feel a bit nauseous.

example.zh: 她从小就开始学习中国古典舞蹈。
example.en: She started learning Chinese classical dance as a child.

副.gloss: vice-; deputy; secondary; measure word for pairs or sets (glasses, gloves)
副.indonesian: wakil; sekunder; kata penggolong untuk pasangan atau set (kacamata, sarung tangan)

example.zh: 我昨天新配了一副眼镜。
example.en: I got a new pair of glasses yesterday.

example.zh: 这次事件引起了社会的广泛关注。
example.en: This incident attracted wide public attention.

example.zh: 我们公司的网站昨天受到了黑客攻击。
example.en: Our company's website was attacked by hackers yesterday.

example.zh: 他试图说服父母让他出国留学。
example.en: He tried to persuade his parents to let him study abroad.

淘汰.gloss: to eliminate (in a competition); to phase out; to weed out

example.zh: 我们队在第一轮比赛中就被淘汰了。
example.en: Our team was eliminated in the first round.

example.zh: 这种玻璃非常结实，连子弹都打不穿。
example.en: This kind of glass is very strong; even bullets can't go through it.

example.zh: 学校经常给学生讲毒品的危害。
example.en: The school often teaches students about the dangers of drugs.

袭击.gloss: to attack by surprise; to raid; to strike (of storms); attack

example.zh: 台风昨晚袭击了南方沿海城市。
example.en: The typhoon hit the southern coastal cities last night.

example.zh: 好的音乐能打动人的灵魂。
example.en: Good music can touch people's souls.

爆炸.gloss: to explode; explosion; to boom (e.g. information)

example.zh: 现在是信息爆炸的时代，我们每天都看到大量新闻。
example.en: This is an age of information explosion; we see a huge amount of news every day.

example.zh: 你手里拿的是什么新玩意儿？
example.en: What's that new gadget in your hand?

盯.gloss: to stare at; to gaze at; to keep an eye on

example.zh: 他一直盯着手机屏幕，连饭都忘了吃。
example.en: He kept staring at his phone screen and even forgot to eat.

example.zh: 我当时做了一个非常愚蠢的决定。
example.en: I made a very stupid decision back then.

跟踪.gloss: to follow; to track; to tail

example.zh: 这个软件可以跟踪你每天走的步数。
example.en: This app can track the number of steps you walk each day.

example.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个富翁的儿子被绑架的故事。
example.en: This film tells the story of a rich man's son who is kidnapped.

example.zh: 我们必须按时把货送到客户手里。
example.en: We must deliver the goods to the client on time.

example.zh: 他爷爷年轻时是一位有名的将军。
example.en: His grandfather was a famous general when he was young.

州.gloss: state (e.g. of the USA); prefecture; province (historical)

example.zh: 他在美国加利福尼亚州读大学。
example.en: He goes to university in the state of California in the USA.

毫无.gloss: to have no ... at all; completely without; not in the least
毫无.indonesian: sama sekali tidak ada; tanpa ... sedikit pun

example.zh: 他对这件事毫无兴趣。
example.en: He has no interest at all in this matter.

example.zh: 那个小偷最后被警察逮捕了。
example.en: The thief was finally arrested by the police.

example.zh: 我们家一共有五个成员。
example.en: There are five members in our family.

监视.gloss: to monitor; to watch over; to keep under surveillance

example.zh: 这台设备可以监视病人的心跳。
example.en: This device can monitor a patient's heartbeat.

example.zh: 医生警告他必须马上戒烟。
example.en: The doctor warned him that he must quit smoking immediately.

example.zh: 我想尝试一下这家新开的餐厅。
example.en: I want to try this newly opened restaurant.

搭.gloss: to put up; to build; to travel by (car, plane, etc.); to go with

example.zh: 我打算搭明天早上的飞机去上海。
example.en: I plan to take tomorrow morning's flight to Shanghai.

搭档.gloss: partner; to team up; to cooperate

example.zh: 他俩是多年的工作搭档，配合得很好。
example.en: The two of them have been work partners for years and cooperate very well.

对付.gloss: to deal with; to cope with; to make do

example.zh: 这道难题我一个人对付不了。
example.en: I can't deal with this tough problem on my own.

example.zh: 能和您一起工作，我感到非常荣幸。
example.en: I feel very honoured to be able to work with you.

example.zh: 买票的队伍排得特别长。
example.en: The line to buy tickets is extremely long.

example.zh: 这位老同志在工厂里工作了四十年。
example.en: This veteran comrade worked in the factory for forty years.

example.zh: 这位歌手是很多年轻人的偶像。
example.en: This singer is an idol to many young people.

example.zh: 他十八岁那年加入了军队。
example.en: He joined the army when he was eighteen.

example.zh: 我小时候最喜欢看侦探小说。
example.en: When I was little I loved reading detective novels.

example.zh: 出门前请确保所有窗户都关好了。
example.en: Before leaving, please make sure all windows are closed.

耍.gloss: to play with; to show off; to play tricks on; to throw (a tantrum)

example.zh: 你别耍我了，快说实话吧。
example.en: Stop messing with me and tell the truth.

example.zh: 球员们一直战斗到比赛的最后一分钟。
example.en: The players fought on until the last minute of the match.

展示.gloss: to show; to display; to exhibit

example.zh: 学生们在会上展示了自己的作品。
example.en: The students displayed their own work at the meeting.

example.zh: 这个项目最近进展得很顺利。
example.en: This project has been progressing smoothly recently.

example.zh: 如果你需要帮助，我很乐意帮忙。
example.en: If you need help, I'm happy to help.

丢三落四.gloss: forgetful; scatterbrained; always leaving things behind
丢三落四.indonesian: pelupa; ceroboh; sering lupa menaruh barang

example.zh: 他总是丢三落四，今天又忘带钥匙了。
example.en: He's always forgetting things; today he forgot his keys again.

解雇.gloss: to fire; to dismiss; to lay off

example.zh: 他因为经常迟到被公司解雇了。
example.en: He was fired by the company for often being late.

example.zh: 大学时光是我一生中最快乐的日子。
example.en: My university years were the happiest days of my life.

无辜.indonesian: tidak bersalah; orang yang tak bersalah

example.zh: 别把气撒在无辜的人身上。
example.en: Don't take your anger out on innocent people.

example.zh: 很多人对在公众面前讲话感到恐惧。
example.en: Many people are afraid of speaking in public.

example.zh: 听到这个消息，大家都很惊讶。
example.en: Everyone was very surprised to hear the news.

example.zh: 她把全部精力都放在了事业上。
example.en: She put all her energy into her career.

不可思议.indonesian: tak terbayangkan; luar biasa; sulit dipercaya

example.zh: 他一天就学会了游泳，真是不可思议。
example.en: He learned to swim in one day; it's really incredible.

example.zh: 这位律师处理过很多复杂的案件。
example.en: This lawyer has handled many complicated cases.

example.zh: 公司的人事档案都保存在这个房间里。
example.en: The company's personnel files are all kept in this room.

协议.gloss: agreement; pact; protocol; to agree on

example.zh: 双方经过讨论，终于签订了合作协议。
example.en: After discussion, both sides finally signed a cooperation agreement.

example.zh: 这家商店晚上被抢劫了，幸好没人受伤。
example.en: The store was robbed at night; luckily no one was hurt.

example.zh: 为了成功，他付出了很大的代价。
example.en: He paid a high price for his success.

example.zh: 他永远不会背叛自己的朋友。
example.en: He will never betray his friends.

example.zh: 对喜欢读书的人来说，图书馆就是天堂。
example.en: For people who love reading, the library is paradise.

释放.gloss: to release; to set free; to give off (energy)

example.zh: 运动可以帮助我们释放压力。
example.en: Exercise can help us release stress.

执行.gloss: to carry out; to execute; to implement

example.zh: 新的规定从下个月开始执行。
example.en: The new regulations will be carried out starting next month.

报警.gloss: to call the police; to report to the police; to raise an alarm
报警.indonesian: melapor ke polisi; memanggil polisi; membunyikan alarm

example.zh: 发现钱包被偷后，他马上打电话报警。
example.en: After finding his wallet stolen, he immediately called the police.

折.gloss: to break; to fold; to convert into; discount (e.g. 20% off)

example.zh: 这件衣服打八折，只要两百块。
example.en: This piece of clothing is 20% off, only two hundred yuan.

example.zh: 失眠的问题已经折磨了他好几年。
example.en: Insomnia has tormented him for several years.

卷.gloss: to roll up; roll; measure word for rolls and volumes
卷.indonesian: menggulung; gulungan; kata penggolong untuk gulungan atau jilid

example.zh: 他把地图卷起来放进了包里。
example.en: He rolled up the map and put it in his bag.

艘.gloss: measure word for boats and ships

example.zh: 港口里停着好几艘大船。
example.en: Several big ships are docked in the harbour.

example.zh: 这部电视剧讲的是一个罪犯重新做人的故事。
example.en: This TV drama tells the story of a criminal who turns over a new leaf.

example.zh: 公司花了很多钱收集市场情报。
example.en: The company spent a lot of money collecting market intelligence.

刺.gloss: thorn; splinter; to prick; to stab

example.zh: 玫瑰花很漂亮，但是它有刺。
example.en: Roses are beautiful, but they have thorns.

example.zh: 父母应该用沟通代替暴力来教育孩子。
example.en: Parents should educate children through communication instead of violence.

example.zh: 下雨天开车要小心，容易发生交通事故。
example.en: Drive carefully on rainy days; traffic accidents happen easily.

example.zh: 考试前他的神经一直很紧张。
example.en: Before the exam his nerves were on edge the whole time.

牺牲.gloss: to sacrifice; to give up; sacrifice; to die for a cause

example.zh: 她为了照顾孩子牺牲了很多休息时间。
example.en: She sacrificed a lot of her rest time to look after the children.

example.zh: 听到这个不公平的决定，大家都非常愤怒。
example.en: Everyone was furious when they heard about this unfair decision.

example.zh: 婴儿每天需要睡十几个小时。
example.en: Babies need to sleep more than ten hours a day.

example.zh: 从塔顶可以看到整个城市的美景。
example.en: From the top of the tower you can see the whole city.

example.zh: 每个人都有选择自己信仰的自由。
example.en: Everyone has the freedom to choose their own beliefs.

example.zh: 教练训练我们的时候简直像个魔鬼。
example.en: When the coach trains us, he's like a devil.

example.zh: 刚到国外的时候，他常常觉得很孤独。
example.en: When he first went abroad, he often felt very lonely.

example.zh: 老师没有惩罚他，而是耐心地跟他谈话。
example.en: The teacher didn't punish him but talked with him patiently.

example.zh: 这种药的效果非常神奇。
example.en: The effect of this medicine is amazing.

磅.gloss: pound (weight or currency); scale; to weigh
磅.indonesian: pon (berat atau mata uang); timbangan; menimbang

example.zh: 这条鱼足足有十磅重。
example.en: This fish weighs a full ten pounds.

承诺.gloss: to promise; to commit to; promise

example.zh: 公司承诺七天内给顾客退款。
example.en: The company promises to refund customers within seven days.

example.zh: 他最喜欢看关于间谍的电影。
example.en: His favourite films are about spies.

确信.gloss: to be sure; to firmly believe; to be convinced

example.zh: 我确信他一定能通过这次考试。
example.en: I'm convinced he will pass this exam.

哼.gloss: to hum; to snort; humph (showing displeasure)

example.zh: 她一边做饭一边哼着歌。
example.en: She hummed a song while cooking.

example.zh: 我叫错了他的名字，场面非常尴尬。
example.en: I called him by the wrong name, and it was very awkward.

example.zh: 海洋里生活着各种各样的生物。
example.en: All kinds of living things live in the ocean.

example.zh: 早餐能给我们提供一上午的能量。
example.en: Breakfast can give us energy for the whole morning.

清醒.gloss: clear-headed; sober; awake; to come to
清醒.indonesian: sadar; jernih pikirannya; tidak mabuk; siuman

example.zh: 喝杯咖啡能让我的头脑清醒一点儿。
example.en: A cup of coffee helps my mind become a bit clearer.

指望.gloss: to count on; to look forward to; hope

example.zh: 你不能什么事都指望别人帮你做。
example.en: You can't count on others to do everything for you.

染.gloss: to dye; to catch (a disease); to be tainted by

example.zh: 她把头发染成了浅棕色。
example.en: She dyed her hair light brown.

example.zh: 他的笑声感染了在场的每一个人。
example.en: His laughter infected everyone present.

抛弃.gloss: to abandon; to discard; to cast aside

example.zh: 我们不应该抛弃自己的梦想。
example.en: We shouldn't abandon our dreams.

example.zh: 音乐厅里传来了美妙的钢琴声。
example.en: Beautiful piano music came from the concert hall.

example.zh: 小时候弟弟做错事，常常被爸爸揍。
example.en: When my little brother did something wrong as a child, he often got spanked by Dad.

擅长.gloss: to be good at; to be skilled in

example.zh: 她擅长用简单的语言解释复杂的问题。
example.en: She is good at explaining complicated problems in simple language.

忍受.gloss: to bear; to endure; to tolerate

example.zh: 我实在忍受不了邻居家的噪音了。
example.en: I really can't stand the noise from the neighbours anymore.

动手.gloss: to start work; to get to work; to touch; to hit someone
动手.indonesian: mulai bekerja; turun tangan; menyentuh; memukul

example.zh: 时间不多了，我们赶快动手吧。
example.en: There isn't much time left, let's get to work.

清理.gloss: to clean up; to clear out; to sort out

example.zh: 周末我要把房间彻底清理一遍。
example.en: This weekend I'm going to clean out my room thoroughly.

example.zh: 所有准备工作已经完毕，晚会可以开始了。
example.en: All the preparations are finished, and the party can begin.

example.zh: 这家研究机构专门研究环境问题。
example.en: This research institution specializes in environmental issues.

即将.gloss: about to; soon; on the verge of

example.zh: 新学期即将开始，同学们都在做准备。
example.en: The new term is about to begin, and the students are getting ready.

example.zh: 这枚钻石戒指是他送给妻子的礼物。
example.en: This diamond ring is his gift to his wife.

example.zh: 经过一段艰难的时期，公司终于好转了。
example.en: After a difficult period, the company finally improved.

坦白.gloss: honest; frank; to confess; to come clean

example.zh: 坦白地说，我不太喜欢这个方案。
example.en: To be honest, I don't really like this plan.

example.zh: 她每年都会把一部分收入捐给慈善机构。
example.en: Every year she donates part of her income to charity.

example.zh: 桌子上还留着咖啡杯的痕迹。
example.en: There are still marks from a coffee cup on the table.

example.zh: 这个区域禁止吸烟，请到外面去抽。
example.en: Smoking is prohibited in this area; please go outside to smoke.

镜头.gloss: camera lens; shot; scene (in a film)

example.zh: 这部电影里最感人的镜头让我哭了。
example.en: The most touching scene in this film made me cry.

example.zh: 几家小公司组成了联盟，共同开发新产品。
example.en: Several small companies formed an alliance to develop new products together.

example.zh: 这个案子下个月将在法院进行审判。
example.en: This case will be tried in court next month.

基地.gloss: base; base of operations; centre (for production or training)

example.zh: 这里是全国最大的蔬菜生产基地。
example.en: This is the largest vegetable production base in the country.

嫉妒.gloss: to be jealous of; to envy; jealousy

example.zh: 她不嫉妒别人的成功，而是向他们学习。
example.en: She doesn't envy others' success but learns from them instead.

example.zh: 我哥哥年轻时组过一个摇滚乐队。
example.en: My older brother formed a rock band when he was young.

example.zh: 父母工作太忙，只好请了一个保姆。
example.en: The parents were too busy with work, so they had to hire a nanny.

打架.gloss: to fight; to scuffle; to come to blows

example.zh: 这两个孩子为了一个玩具打架了。
example.en: These two kids got into a fight over a toy.

天赋.gloss: natural talent; gift; to be endowed with

example.zh: 她在音乐方面很有天赋。
example.en: She has a natural talent for music.

打击.gloss: to hit; to strike; to crack down on; blow (setback)

example.zh: 这次失败对他的打击很大。
example.en: This failure was a big blow to him.

example.zh: 我以前也遇到过类似的问题。
example.en: I've also run into similar problems before.

example.zh: 她对工作一直充满激情。
example.en: She has always been full of passion for her work.

example.zh: 护士给孩子注射了疫苗。
example.en: The nurse gave the child a vaccine injection.

转移.gloss: to shift; to transfer; to divert (attention)

example.zh: 他想通过运动来转移注意力。
example.en: He wants to divert his attention through exercise.

摆脱.gloss: to get rid of; to break away from; to free oneself from
摆脱.indonesian: melepaskan diri dari; terbebas dari; menyingkirkan

example.zh: 他终于摆脱了熬夜的坏习惯。
example.en: He finally got rid of the bad habit of staying up late.

example.zh: 手机已经成了我们生活中的好助手。
example.en: The mobile phone has become a good helper in our lives.

保密.gloss: to keep secret; to keep confidential

example.zh: 这件事请你一定要保密。
example.en: Please be sure to keep this a secret.

栋.indonesian: kata penggolong untuk bangunan; balok bubungan

example.zh: 这栋楼一共有三十层。
example.en: This building has thirty floors in total.

example.zh: 秋天的西湖特别迷人。
example.en: West Lake in autumn is especially charming.

除.gloss: to remove; to get rid of; except; to divide (mathematics)

example.zh: 除了周末，他每天都要去公司上班。
example.en: Except for weekends, he goes to the office every day.

开除.gloss: to expel; to dismiss; to kick out

example.zh: 他因为考试作弊被学校开除了。
example.en: He was expelled from school for cheating in an exam.

example.zh: 毕业仪式将在下周五举行。
example.en: The graduation ceremony will be held next Friday.

example.zh: 大雪导致机场的交通一片混乱。
example.en: The heavy snow threw traffic at the airport into chaos.

联络.gloss: to contact; to get in touch; liaison; contact

example.zh: 毕业以后，我们一直保持联络。
example.en: After graduation, we have kept in touch.

example.zh: 吸烟会增加得癌症的风险。
example.en: Smoking increases the risk of getting cancer.

example.zh: 他每天早上都在公园里练剑。
example.en: Every morning he practises sword exercises in the park.

example.zh: 大家都说他是一个数学天才。
example.en: Everyone says he is a maths genius.

发射.gloss: to launch; to fire; to emit

example.zh: 这颗卫星将于明天上午发射。
example.en: This satellite will be launched tomorrow morning.

example.zh: 水是人类生存必不可少的条件。
example.en: Water is an indispensable condition for human survival.

example.zh: 这部小说的结局出乎所有人的意料。
example.en: The ending of this novel surprised everyone.

example.zh: 在这里停车是非法的，会被罚款。
example.en: Parking here is illegal and you'll be fined.

人家.gloss: others; other people; he or she; I (coy, colloquial); household
人家.indonesian: orang lain; dia; aku (manja, lisan); keluarga atau rumah tangga

example.zh: 人家都已经道歉了，你就原谅他吧。
example.en: He has already apologized, so just forgive him.

example.zh: 我们应该了解孩子学习的动机。
example.en: We should understand children's motivation for learning.

欺骗.gloss: to deceive; to cheat; to dupe

example.zh: 广告不应该欺骗消费者。
example.en: Advertisements should not deceive consumers.

example.zh: 成功并非一件容易的事。
example.en: Success is by no means an easy thing.

example.zh: 这部电影讲述了警察解救人质的故事。
example.en: This film tells the story of the police rescuing hostages.

扮演.gloss: to play the role of; to act as

example.zh: 她在电影里扮演一位中学老师。
example.en: She plays a middle-school teacher in the film.

example.zh: 科学家们一直在探索宇宙的秘密。
example.en: Scientists have long been exploring the secrets of the universe.

example.zh: 演员们拿到剧本后马上开始排练。
example.en: The actors started rehearsing as soon as they got the script.

证实.gloss: to confirm; to verify; to prove

example.zh: 研究证实，适量运动对健康有好处。
example.en: Research confirms that moderate exercise is good for health.

example.zh: 法官让被告说明当时的情况。
example.en: The judge asked the defendant to explain what happened at the time.

扣.gloss: to button; to buckle; to deduct; button; knot
扣.indonesian: mengancingkan; mengaitkan; memotong (gaji atau poin); kancing; simpul

example.zh: 他上班迟到，被扣了一百块工资。
example.en: He was late for work and had one hundred yuan deducted from his pay.

example.zh: 现在还不是告诉他的最好时机。
example.en: Now is not the best time to tell him.

辩护.gloss: to defend; to speak in defence of; to plead (in court)

example.zh: 你不用为他的错误辩护了。
example.en: You don't have to defend his mistakes.

example.zh: 从这里到机场起码要一个小时。
example.en: It takes at least an hour to get from here to the airport.

隐瞒.gloss: to conceal; to hide; to cover up

example.zh: 有什么问题，你不要对医生隐瞒。
example.en: If you have any problems, don't hide them from the doctor.

example.zh: 我宁愿走路去，也不想挤公交车。
example.en: I'd rather walk than squeeze onto the bus.

example.zh: 我们社区经常组织老人参加活动。
example.en: Our community often organizes activities for the elderly.

example.zh: 她现在是总经理的助理。
example.en: She is now the general manager's assistant.

渴望.gloss: to long for; to yearn for; to thirst for

example.zh: 这些孩子渴望得到更好的教育。
example.en: These children long for a better education.

溜.gloss: to slip away; to sneak off; to glide; to slide

example.zh: 会议还没结束，他就偷偷溜走了。
example.en: Before the meeting was over, he quietly slipped away.

example.zh: 小时候我梦想有一天能去太空旅行。
example.en: As a child I dreamed of travelling to space one day.

example.zh: 恐龙为什么会毁灭，至今还是一个谜。
example.en: Why the dinosaurs were wiped out is still a mystery today.

眼神.gloss: expression in one's eyes; look; eyesight (dialect)

example.zh: 从他的眼神里，我看出了他的担心。
example.en: I could see his worry in his eyes.

example.zh: 这位作家性格有点儿古怪，不太喜欢说话。
example.en: This writer is a bit eccentric and doesn't like to talk much.

example.zh: 下半场我们队加强了进攻，终于进了一个球。
example.en: In the second half our team stepped up the attack and finally scored a goal.

报复.gloss: to take revenge; to retaliate; revenge

example.zh: 他说的话让你生气，但你不应该报复他。
example.en: What he said made you angry, but you shouldn't take revenge on him.

example.zh: 这个说法太荒谬了，根本没有科学根据。
example.en: This claim is too absurd; it has no scientific basis at all.

拨.gloss: to dial; to move with the hand; to allocate (funds)

example.zh: 我拨了好几次他的电话，都没人接。
example.en: I dialled his number several times, but nobody answered.

example.zh: 月亮是地球唯一的天然卫星。
example.en: The moon is the earth's only natural satellite.

期望.gloss: to hope; to expect; expectation; hope

example.zh: 父母对孩子的期望不应该太高。
example.en: Parents' expectations of their children shouldn't be too high.

嘲笑.gloss: to laugh at; to mock; to ridicule

example.zh: 别嘲笑别人的口音，学外语本来就不容易。
example.en: Don't laugh at other people's accents; learning a foreign language isn't easy.

example.zh: 如果我刚才的话冒犯了您，请原谅。
example.en: If what I just said offended you, please forgive me.

example.zh: 女儿最喜欢的礼物是一个布娃娃。
example.en: My daughter's favourite present is a rag doll.

example.zh: 经过三个小时的讨论，双方终于达成了一致。
example.en: After three hours of discussion, the two sides finally reached agreement.

example.zh: 这对老夫妇每天傍晚都手拉手去散步。
example.en: This elderly couple goes for a walk hand in hand every evening.

example.zh: 婚礼上的新娘看起来特别幸福。
example.en: The bride at the wedding looked especially happy.

example.zh: 她打算竞选学生会主席。
example.en: She plans to run for president of the student union.

example.zh: 他们俩从小一起长大，关系非常亲密。
example.en: The two of them grew up together and are very close.

割.gloss: to cut; to mow; to sever

example.zh: 爷爷正在院子里割草。
example.en: Grandpa is cutting the grass in the yard.

制服.gloss: uniform; to subdue; to bring under control

example.zh: 这所学校的学生都要穿制服。
example.en: Students at this school all have to wear uniforms.

直播.gloss: live broadcast; livestream; to broadcast live
直播.indonesian: siaran langsung; siaran live; menyiarkan langsung

example.zh: 今晚的足球比赛会在电视上直播。
example.en: Tonight's football match will be broadcast live on TV.

崩溃.gloss: to collapse; to break down; to fall apart

example.zh: 连续加班一个月，他觉得自己快崩溃了。
example.en: After working overtime for a month straight, he feels he's about to break down.

example.zh: 这个国家的人们有不同的宗教信仰。
example.en: People in this country have different religious beliefs.

乘.gloss: to ride; to take (transport); to take advantage of; to multiply

example.zh: 我们乘地铁去博物馆吧。
example.en: Let's take the subway to the museum.

陷入.gloss: to fall into; to sink into; to be caught up in
陷入.indonesian: terjerumus ke; tenggelam dalam; terjebak dalam

example.zh: 听完他的话，大家都陷入了沉默。
example.en: After hearing what he said, everyone fell silent.

回报.gloss: to repay; to reciprocate; return; reward

example.zh: 父母养育我们，从来不要求回报。
example.en: Our parents raised us without ever asking for anything in return.

example.zh: 这种新药还在试验阶段。
example.en: This new medicine is still in the testing stage.

example.zh: 今年夏天的天气异常炎热。
example.en: The weather this summer is unusually hot.

example.zh: 良好的生活习惯可以预防很多疾病。
example.en: Good living habits can prevent many diseases.

展现.gloss: to show; to display; to unfold before one's eyes
展现.indonesian: menampilkan; memperlihatkan; terbentang di depan mata

example.zh: 这次比赛展现了年轻选手的实力。
example.en: This competition showed the strength of the young players.

example.zh: 父母不应该强迫孩子学自己不喜欢的东西。
example.en: Parents shouldn't force their children to learn things they don't like.

暗示.gloss: to hint; to suggest; hint; suggestion

example.zh: 她看了看手表，暗示我们该走了。
example.en: She glanced at her watch, hinting that we should leave.

当事人.gloss: person involved; party (to a lawsuit); client (of a lawyer)
当事人.indonesian: pihak yang bersangkutan; pihak berperkara; klien (pengacara)

example.zh: 这件事最好让当事人自己来解释。
example.en: It's best to let the person involved explain this themselves.

绝望.gloss: to despair; to give up hope; desperate; despair

example.zh: 即使遇到再大的困难，也不要绝望。
example.en: No matter how great the difficulties, don't despair.

example.zh: 比赛输了以后，队员们都很沮丧。
example.en: After losing the match, the players were all very dejected.

example.zh: 那场大地震给当地带来了巨大的灾难。
example.en: That big earthquake brought a huge disaster to the area.

example.zh: 这部电影告诉我们，正义终将战胜邪恶。
example.en: This film tells us that justice will eventually triumph over evil.

example.zh: 这个奖是我们全队的荣誉。
example.en: This award is an honour for our whole team.

example.zh: 写作也需要掌握一定的技巧。
example.en: Writing also requires mastering certain techniques.

example.zh: 我提议大家周末一起去爬山。
example.en: I propose we all go hiking together this weekend.

example.zh: 广场中央有一座漂亮的喷泉。
example.en: There is a beautiful fountain in the middle of the square.

example.zh: 即便明天下雨，比赛也会照常进行。
example.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, the match will go ahead as usual.

机密.indonesian: rahasia; rahasia negara atau perusahaan; bersifat rahasia

example.zh: 这些文件涉及公司的商业机密。
example.en: These documents involve the company's trade secrets.

example.zh: 狗是对主人最忠诚的动物。
example.en: Dogs are the animals most loyal to their owners.

example.zh: 请不要在走廊里大声说话。
example.en: Please don't talk loudly in the corridor.

example.zh: 感冒的常见症状是头疼和咳嗽。
example.en: Common symptoms of a cold are headaches and coughing.

当初.gloss: at that time; originally; in the first place

example.zh: 早知道这样，当初就应该听你的。
example.en: If I'd known it would turn out like this, I should have listened to you in the first place.

example.zh: 这家公司推出了一系列新产品。
example.en: This company has launched a series of new products.

example.zh: 天气冷了，你在外面要多保重。
example.en: It's getting cold; take good care of yourself out there.

example.zh: 这个消息让全世界都感到震惊。
example.en: This news shocked the whole world.

反抗.gloss: to resist; to revolt; to rebel against

example.zh: 青春期的孩子常常会反抗父母的管教。
example.en: Teenagers often rebel against their parents' discipline.

example.zh: 读一本好书可以让心灵得到安静。
example.en: Reading a good book can bring peace to the soul.

掩护.gloss: to cover; to shield; to screen; cover

example.zh: 他借着人群的掩护，悄悄离开了会场。
example.en: Using the crowd as cover, he quietly left the venue.

example.zh: 年轻人给公司带来了新的活力。
example.en: Young people have brought new vitality to the company.

example.zh: 他天生就有一副好嗓子。
example.en: He was born with a good voice.

枚.gloss: measure word for coins, medals, rings, stamps, etc.
枚.indonesian: kata penggolong untuk koin, medali, cincin, perangko, dll.

example.zh: 他在比赛中获得了一枚金牌。
example.en: He won a gold medal in the competition.

不止.gloss: more than; not limited to; incessantly

example.zh: 这个问题我已经解释了不止一次了。
example.en: I've explained this question more than once already.

example.zh: 他是我们公司的法律顾问。
example.en: He is our company's legal adviser.

example.zh: 语言不再是我们交流的障碍了。
example.en: Language is no longer a barrier to our communication.

example.zh: 这家公司正面临严重的经济危机。
example.en: This company is facing a serious economic crisis.

维持.gloss: to maintain; to keep; to preserve

example.zh: 上大学时，他靠打工维持生活。
example.en: At university, he supported himself by doing part-time work.

保守.gloss: conservative; to keep (a secret); to guard

example.zh: 他的想法比较保守，不太愿意冒险。
example.en: His thinking is rather conservative, and he's not very willing to take risks.

主管.gloss: person in charge; supervisor; to be in charge of

example.zh: 有问题请直接找我们部门的主管。
example.en: If you have a problem, please go directly to our department supervisor.

example.zh: 他是一个乐观主义者，总是往好的方面想。
example.en: He is an optimist and always looks on the bright side.

罐.gloss: can; jar; pot; measure word for cans and jars
罐.indonesian: kaleng; stoples; guci; kata penggolong untuk kaleng atau stoples

example.zh: 我在超市买了两罐可乐。
example.en: I bought two cans of cola at the supermarket.

example.zh: 他每天都会在网上发一个做饭的视频。
example.en: Every day he posts a cooking video online.

治安.gloss: public order; public security; law and order

example.zh: 这个城市的治安很好，晚上出门也很安全。
example.en: Public order in this city is good; it's safe to go out at night.

example.zh: 请在重要的地方做个标记。
example.en: Please put a mark at the important places.

出卖.gloss: to betray; to sell out; to sell

example.zh: 他是我最好的朋友，绝不会出卖我。
example.en: He's my best friend and would never sell me out.

昏迷.gloss: to lose consciousness; to be in a coma; coma

example.zh: 病人昏迷了两天以后终于醒过来了。
example.en: The patient finally came round after being unconscious for two days.

example.zh: 他昨天工作到凌晨两点才睡。
example.en: Yesterday he worked until two in the morning before going to bed.

example.zh: 你这样说是对他的侮辱。
example.en: Saying that is an insult to him.

暴露.gloss: to expose; to reveal; to lay bare

example.zh: 皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下容易晒伤。
example.en: Skin exposed to the sun for a long time burns easily.

example.zh: 他很有绅士风度，总是让女士先走。
example.en: He is very gentlemanly and always lets ladies go first.

example.zh: 每个公民都有受教育的权利。
example.en: Every citizen has the right to education.

example.zh: 把小狗扔在路边是很残忍的行为。
example.en: Abandoning a puppy by the roadside is very cruel.

example.zh: 这座建筑的造型非常独特。
example.en: The design of this building is very unique.

example.zh: 天气还没有好转的迹象。
example.en: There's still no sign of the weather improving.

example.zh: 在很多人心中，教师是一份神圣的职业。
example.en: In many people's eyes, teaching is a sacred profession.

example.zh: 他毕业后进入一家航空公司工作。
example.en: After graduating he went to work for an airline.

example.zh: 这些货物都存放在仓库里。
example.en: These goods are all stored in the warehouse.

example.zh: 我们在码头等了半个小时，船才到。
example.en: We waited at the pier for half an hour before the boat arrived.

本人.indonesian: yang bersangkutan; secara langsung; saya sendiri (formal)

example.zh: 办理护照必须本人到场。
example.en: To apply for a passport you must appear in person.

大不了.gloss: at worst; if worst comes to worst; serious (usually with a negative)
大不了.indonesian: paling buruk; kalau terpaksa; serius (biasanya dalam kalimat negatif)

example.zh: 大不了重新做一遍，没什么好怕的。
example.en: At worst we'll just do it again; there's nothing to be afraid of.

补偿.gloss: to compensate; to make up for; compensation

example.zh: 航班取消了，航空公司给了乘客一些补偿。
example.en: The flight was cancelled, and the airline gave the passengers some compensation.

example.zh: 生气的时候，千万不要冲动地做决定。
example.en: When you're angry, never make decisions on impulse.

演奏.gloss: to perform (on a musical instrument); to play

example.zh: 她在音乐会上演奏了一首钢琴曲。
example.en: She performed a piano piece at the concert.

对抗.gloss: to resist; to oppose; to confront; confrontation

example.zh: 两支球队的对抗非常激烈。
example.en: The contest between the two teams was very intense.

example.zh: 这座古老的城堡吸引了很多游客。
example.en: This ancient castle attracts many tourists.

example.zh: 问题本身并不难，难的是找到时间去解决。
example.en: The problem itself isn't hard; what's hard is finding time to solve it.

example.zh: 工作累了，他喜欢去按摩放松一下。
example.en: When he's tired from work, he likes to get a massage to relax.

熬.gloss: to stay up (late at night); to endure; to simmer; to boil

example.zh: 为了准备考试，他熬了好几个通宵。
example.en: He stayed up all night several times to prepare for the exam.

example.zh: 不要成为金钱的奴隶。
example.en: Don't become a slave to money.

在意.gloss: to care about; to mind; to take to heart

example.zh: 别太在意别人怎么看你。
example.en: Don't care too much about what others think of you.

拜访.gloss: to pay a visit; to call on

example.zh: 周末我打算去拜访一位老朋友。
example.en: This weekend I plan to visit an old friend.

example.zh: 考试考得好，妈妈奖励了我一部新手机。
example.en: I did well in the exam, so Mum rewarded me with a new phone.

example.zh: 他跑步时摔倒了，膝盖受了点儿伤。
example.en: He fell while running and slightly hurt his knee.

example.zh: 汽车的引擎突然发出奇怪的声音。
example.en: The car's engine suddenly made a strange noise.

宰.gloss: to slaughter; to butcher; to rip off (overcharge, colloquial)

example.zh: 这家饭店专门宰游客，价格贵得离谱。
example.en: This restaurant specializes in ripping off tourists; its prices are outrageous.

example.zh: 昨天晚上邻居家进贼了。
example.en: A thief broke into the neighbours' house last night.

example.zh: 不同种族的人应该互相尊重。
example.en: People of different races should respect one another.

example.zh: 汤太烫了，把我的舌头烫了一下。
example.en: The soup was too hot and burned my tongue.

消灭.gloss: to eliminate; to wipe out; to exterminate

example.zh: 这种药可以消灭体内的细菌。
example.en: This medicine can wipe out bacteria in the body.

example.zh: 读书给我带来了很多乐趣。
example.en: Reading has brought me a lot of pleasure.

example.zh: 虐待动物是违法的行为。
example.en: Abusing animals is illegal.

example.zh: 小狗高兴地舔着主人的手。
example.en: The puppy happily licked its owner's hand.

example.zh: 这份工作薪水不高，但是很稳定。
example.en: This job doesn't pay much, but it's very stable.

example.zh: 遇到问题时要保持理智。
example.en: When you run into problems, stay rational.

example.zh: 他决定通过法律诉讼来解决这个问题。
example.en: He decided to settle this issue through a lawsuit.

封锁.gloss: to block off; to seal off; to blockade

example.zh: 因为下大雪，这条公路被封锁了。
example.en: This highway was closed off because of heavy snow.

example.zh: 孩子的长相和父母的基因有很大关系。
example.en: A child's looks have a lot to do with the parents' genes.

example.zh: 她申请了一个经理的职位。
example.en: She applied for a manager's position.

example.zh: 这些蚊子真可恶，咬得我睡不着觉。
example.en: These mosquitoes are so annoying; their bites kept me awake.

example.zh: 我还不知道确切的出发时间。
example.en: I don't know the exact departure time yet.

支援.gloss: to support; to assist; to aid; support

example.zh: 很多医生主动去支援偏远地区的医院。
example.en: Many doctors volunteered to support hospitals in remote areas.

扎.gloss: to prick; to pierce; to plunge into; to tie (up); to pitch (a tent)
扎.indonesian: menusuk; menancap; menyelam ke; mengikat; mendirikan (tenda)

example.zh: 我的手指被针扎了一下。
example.en: My finger got pricked by a needle.

压制.gloss: to suppress; to stifle; to inhibit

example.zh: 你不应该总是压制自己的情绪。
example.en: You shouldn't always suppress your emotions.

example.zh: 演员们正在为明天的演出排练。
example.en: The actors are rehearsing for tomorrow's performance.

评论.gloss: to comment on; to discuss; comment; review

example.zh: 这篇文章下面有很多读者的评论。
example.en: There are many readers' comments under this article.

example.zh: 学校设立了一个奖学金基金。
example.en: The school has set up a scholarship fund.

投降.gloss: to surrender; to capitulate; to give in

example.zh: 这道题太难了，我投降了，你告诉我答案吧。
example.en: This question is too hard; I give up, just tell me the answer.

example.zh: 这位作家的灵感常常来自日常生活。
example.en: This writer's inspiration often comes from daily life.

example.zh: 我小时候特别喜欢看日本漫画。
example.en: When I was little I especially loved reading Japanese manga.

example.zh: 没有人能准确预言未来会发生什么。
example.en: No one can accurately predict what will happen in the future.

example.zh: 他一个人坐在教室的角落里看书。
example.en: He sat alone in the corner of the classroom reading.

example.zh: 做生意需要灵活的市场策略。
example.en: Doing business requires flexible market strategies.

领先.gloss: to lead; to be in front; to be ahead

example.zh: 上半场结束时，我们队以二比一领先。
example.en: At the end of the first half, our team led two to one.

example.zh: 登山前要准备好所有的装备。
example.en: Before climbing a mountain you must prepare all your gear.

example.zh: 他说话这么没礼貌，简直像个流氓。
example.en: He speaks so rudely; he's practically a hooligan.

声明.gloss: statement; declaration; to declare; to announce

example.zh: 公司发表声明，向所有顾客道歉。
example.en: The company issued a statement apologizing to all its customers.

排除.gloss: to rule out; to eliminate; to remove

example.zh: 医生已经排除了这种病的可能性。
example.en: The doctor has already ruled out the possibility of this illness.

成交.gloss: to close a deal; to strike a bargain; deal!

example.zh: 我们谈了一个下午，最后以两百块的价格成交了。
example.en: We negotiated all afternoon and finally closed the deal at two hundred yuan.

example.zh: 故事里的皇后美丽又善良。
example.en: The empress in the story is beautiful and kind.

example.zh: 学校每学期都会组织一次消防演习。
example.en: The school organizes a fire drill every term.

吼.gloss: to roar; to howl; to shout

example.zh: 你有话好好说，别冲我吼。
example.en: If you have something to say, say it nicely; don't shout at me.

发动.gloss: to start (a machine); to launch; to mobilize

example.zh: 天太冷了，汽车半天发动不起来。
example.en: It was so cold that the car wouldn't start for ages.

example.zh: 他在一家大型企业集团工作。
example.en: He works for a large business group.

example.zh: 请大家协助我们完成这项调查。
example.en: Please help us complete this survey.

example.zh: 家人的支持是我前进的动力。
example.en: My family's support is what drives me forward.

example.zh: 这部小说讲的是宫廷里的阴谋。
example.en: This novel is about scheming at the royal court.

example.zh: 医生及时抢救，保住了他的性命。
example.en: The doctors gave him emergency treatment in time and saved his life.

example.zh: 她是本市摄影协会的会员。
example.en: She is a member of the city's photography association.

example.zh: 我感冒了，喉咙疼得说不出话来。
example.en: I have a cold and my throat hurts so much I can't speak.

爆发.gloss: to break out; to erupt; to explode; outbreak

example.zh: 这座火山上一次爆发是在一百年前。
example.en: This volcano last erupted a hundred years ago.

陷害.gloss: to frame (someone); to set up; to make false charges against

example.zh: 他是被别人陷害的，其实他什么都没做。
example.en: He was framed by someone; actually he didn't do anything.

瞄准.gloss: to aim at; to take aim; to target

example.zh: 这家公司把产品瞄准了年轻人市场。
example.en: This company targeted its products at the youth market.

example.zh: 这里的饮料可以随意取用。
example.en: You can help yourself to the drinks here as you please.

荒唐.indonesian: tidak masuk akal; konyol; tak bermoral

example.zh: 这个想法太荒唐了，没人会同意的。
example.en: This idea is too absurd; no one will agree to it.

策划.gloss: to plan; to plot; to engineer; planner

example.zh: 这次活动是由我们部门策划的。
example.en: This event was planned by our department.

弥补.gloss: to make up for; to remedy; to offset

example.zh: 他想用实际行动来弥补自己的过错。
example.en: He wants to make up for his mistake through concrete actions.

example.zh: 这个国家的两个主要的党在选举中竞争激烈。
example.en: The two main parties in this country compete fiercely in elections.

example.zh: 这篇文章的信息来源很可靠。
example.en: The sources of information in this article are very reliable.

判决.gloss: to judge; to rule; to sentence; verdict

example.zh: 法院判决这家公司赔偿顾客的损失。
example.en: The court ruled that the company must compensate its customers for their losses.

example.zh: 小心，这道题里有一个陷阱。
example.en: Careful, there's a trap in this question.

example.zh: 裁判的判罚很公正，大家都没有意见。
example.en: The referee's decisions were fair, and nobody objected.

依靠.gloss: to rely on; to depend on; support

example.zh: 他从小就学会了依靠自己。
example.en: He learned to rely on himself from a young age.

委托.gloss: to entrust; to commission; to authorize

example.zh: 我委托朋友帮我取一下快递。
example.en: I asked a friend to pick up my parcel for me.

example.zh: 导盲犬可以帮助盲人安全过马路。
example.en: Guide dogs can help blind people cross the road safely.

example.zh: 这两个会议的时间冲突了，我只能参加一个。
example.en: The times of these two meetings clash, so I can only attend one.

example.zh: 请按照屏幕上的指示操作。
example.en: Please follow the instructions on the screen.

example.zh: 她每天出门前都要化妆半个小时。
example.en: She spends half an hour putting on makeup every day before going out.

端.gloss: to carry (holding level); end; extremity; upright
端.indonesian: membawa (dengan tangan, rata); ujung; pangkal; lurus

example.zh: 服务员端来了两碗热汤。
example.en: The waiter brought over two bowls of hot soup.

example.zh: 在背后说别人坏话是很卑鄙的行为。
example.en: Talking badly about people behind their backs is despicable.

example.zh: 很多业内人士都参加了这次会议。
example.en: Many industry insiders attended this conference.

example.zh: 生病的时候，人的心理也会变得很脆弱。
example.en: When people are ill, they also become emotionally fragile.

侵犯.gloss: to infringe on; to violate; to encroach on

example.zh: 未经允许使用别人的照片可能会侵犯肖像权。
example.en: Using someone's photo without permission may infringe their portrait rights.

example.zh: 心脏是人体最重要的器官之一。
example.en: The heart is one of the most important organs of the human body.

考验.gloss: to test; to put to the test; trial

example.zh: 这次困难是对我们友谊的考验。
example.en: This difficulty is a test of our friendship.

崇拜.gloss: to worship; to adore; to idolize

example.zh: 很多孩子都崇拜运动明星。
example.en: Many children idolize sports stars.

example.zh: 他在晚会上表演了一个精彩的魔术。
example.en: He performed a wonderful magic trick at the party.

example.zh: 购物的欲望常常让人花很多钱。
example.en: The urge to shop often makes people spend a lot of money.

example.zh: 这支球队的实力非常强。
example.en: This team is very strong.

example.zh: 赌博不但浪费钱，还会影响家庭。
example.en: Gambling not only wastes money but also affects the family.

example.zh: 我很理解你现在的处境。
example.en: I fully understand your current situation.

继承.gloss: to inherit; to carry on; to succeed

example.zh: 他继承了父亲留下的小饭馆。
example.en: He inherited the small restaurant his father left.

晃.gloss: to sway; to shake; to wander about; to flash past

example.zh: 别晃桌子，我正在写字呢。
example.en: Don't shake the table, I'm writing.

example.zh: 这家工厂雇佣了三百多名工人。
example.en: This factory employs more than three hundred workers.

隔离.gloss: to isolate; to separate; to quarantine; isolation

example.zh: 生病的动物需要和其他动物隔离开。
example.en: Sick animals need to be kept apart from other animals.

企图.gloss: to attempt; to try; attempt (usually negative)

example.zh: 他企图用谎言掩盖自己的错误。
example.en: He tried to cover up his mistakes with lies.

无能为力.gloss: powerless; helpless; unable to do anything about it
无能为力.indonesian: tidak berdaya; tak bisa berbuat apa-apa

example.zh: 对于这件事，我也无能为力。
example.en: There's nothing I can do about this either.

example.zh: 她是这支团队真正的领袖。
example.en: She is the real leader of this team.

example.zh: 被困在网里的小鸟拼命地挣扎着。
example.en: The little bird caught in the net struggled desperately.

丁.gloss: small cube (of food); fourth (in a series); adult man
丁.indonesian: potongan dadu (makanan); keempat (dalam urutan); pria dewasa

example.zh: 把土豆切成丁，然后和肉一起炒。
example.en: Dice the potatoes, then stir-fry them with the meat.

example.zh: 我每天都接到好几个骚扰电话。
example.en: I get several nuisance calls every day.

example.zh: 他当众批评我，让我很难堪。
example.en: He criticized me in public, which embarrassed me.

许可.gloss: to permit; to allow; permission; licence

example.zh: 没有许可，不能进入这个实验室。
example.en: You can't enter this laboratory without permission.

汇报.gloss: to report; to give an account of; report

example.zh: 明天上午我要向经理汇报工作。
example.en: Tomorrow morning I have to report on my work to the manager.

example.zh: 过度使用手机对眼睛不好。
example.en: Overusing mobile phones is bad for your eyes.

example.zh: 吸烟会严重伤害人的肺。
example.en: Smoking seriously harms people's lungs.

提示.gloss: to prompt; to point out; to hint; tip

example.zh: 系统提示我密码输入错误。
example.en: The system told me that the password I entered was wrong.

example.zh: 这个小村庄被大山包围着。
example.en: This small village is surrounded by mountains.

example.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋混合在一起。
example.en: Mix the flour and the eggs together.

example.zh: 你做了一个明智的选择。
example.en: You made a wise choice.

example.zh: 我们要用知识武装自己的头脑。
example.en: We should arm our minds with knowledge.

透露.gloss: to reveal; to disclose; to leak

example.zh: 他还没有透露新电影的名字。
example.en: He hasn't yet revealed the name of the new film.

example.zh: 他和疾病斗争了很多年。
example.en: He struggled against illness for many years.

example.zh: 你的指甲太长了，该剪一剪了。
example.en: Your nails are too long; it's time to cut them.

example.zh: 我们班下周要选举新的班长。
example.en: Our class will elect a new class monitor next week.

足以.gloss: to be enough to; sufficient to

example.zh: 这些证据足以说明他说的是真话。
example.en: This evidence is enough to show that he's telling the truth.

example.zh: 每个人都应该尊重别人的隐私。
example.en: Everyone should respect other people's privacy.

example.zh: 他说话带着很重的南方口音。
example.en: He speaks with a strong southern accent.

旋转.gloss: to rotate; to spin; to revolve

example.zh: 地球一直在围绕太阳旋转。
example.en: The earth keeps revolving around the sun.

穿越.gloss: to pass through; to cross; to travel through (time)

example.zh: 我们花了两天时间穿越这片沙漠。
example.en: It took us two days to cross this desert.

回顾.gloss: to look back on; to review; review

example.zh: 回顾过去的一年，我学到了很多东西。
example.en: Looking back on the past year, I've learned a lot.

example.zh: 蛋糕被压扁了，看起来不太好看。
example.en: The cake got squashed flat and doesn't look very nice.

example.zh: 节日的街上到处都是欢乐的人群。
example.en: The festive streets are full of joyful crowds.

example.zh: 面试是招聘中最重要的环节。
example.en: The interview is the most important stage in recruitment.

抚养.gloss: to raise; to bring up; to foster

example.zh: 她一个人把三个孩子抚养长大。
example.en: She raised three children on her own.

example.zh: 现在的市场竞争非常残酷。
example.en: Market competition nowadays is extremely harsh.

example.zh: 教育孩子是每位老师的使命。
example.en: Educating children is the mission of every teacher.

example.zh: 酒精可以用来给伤口消毒。
example.en: Alcohol can be used to disinfect wounds.

example.zh: 在正式场合，最好穿得正式一点儿。
example.en: On formal occasions, it's best to dress a bit more formally.

example.zh: 他花了一个月做了一个飞机模型。
example.en: He spent a month making a model plane.

example.zh: 现代通讯技术让交流变得很方便。
example.en: Modern communication technology has made exchanges very convenient.

example.zh: 专家正在评估这个项目的风险。
example.en: Experts are assessing the risks of this project.

解除.gloss: to remove; to relieve; to lift; to cancel

example.zh: 经过协商，双方决定解除合同。
example.en: After negotiations, both parties decided to terminate the contract.

给予.gloss: to give; to grant; to render

example.zh: 谢谢大家给予我的帮助和支持。
example.en: Thank you all for the help and support you've given me.

example.zh: 这是一个非常典型的例子。
example.en: This is a very typical example.

伪造.gloss: to forge; to counterfeit; to fake

example.zh: 伪造证件是违法的行为。
example.en: Forging documents is illegal.

掩盖.gloss: to cover up; to conceal; to hide

example.zh: 他用笑容掩盖自己内心的紧张。
example.en: He hid his inner nervousness behind a smile.

团结.gloss: to unite; to rally; united; unity

example.zh: 只要大家团结起来，就没有克服不了的困难。
example.en: As long as we all unite, there is no difficulty we can't overcome.

趴.gloss: to lie on one's stomach; to lean on (a table)

example.zh: 他太累了，趴在桌子上睡着了。
example.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep slumped over the desk.

翘.gloss: to stick up; to bend upwards; to raise (a leg); to skip (class, colloquial)
翘.indonesian: mencuat; melengkung ke atas; mengangkat (kaki); bolos (lisan)

example.zh: 他翘着腿坐在沙发上看电视。
example.en: He sat on the sofa with his legs crossed watching TV.

example.zh: 减肥的时候，最难抵抗的是美食的诱惑。
example.en: When dieting, the hardest thing to resist is the temptation of good food.

example.zh: 这枚火箭将把卫星送上太空。
example.en: This rocket will send the satellite into space.

example.zh: 房租已经成了年轻人很大的负担。
example.en: Rent has become a heavy burden for young people.

example.zh: 车的轮胎坏了，我们只好停在路边。
example.en: The car's tyre was damaged, so we had to stop by the roadside.

example.zh: 买团体票可以便宜很多。
example.en: Buying group tickets can be a lot cheaper.

倾向.gloss: tendency; inclination; to be inclined to

example.zh: 我更倾向于选择第二个方案。
example.en: I'm more inclined to choose the second plan.

遭遇.gloss: to encounter (something bad); to meet with; bad experience
遭遇.indonesian: mengalami (hal buruk); menghadapi; nasib; pengalaman buruk

example.zh: 他在旅途中遭遇了一场大雨。
example.en: He ran into heavy rain during his journey.

统治.gloss: to rule; to govern; rule; dominance

example.zh: 恐龙曾经统治地球很长时间。
example.en: Dinosaurs once ruled the earth for a very long time.

example.zh: 天气太干燥，我的嘴唇都裂开了。
example.en: The weather is so dry that my lips are cracked.

example.zh: 他住在城市的边缘，上班要坐很久的车。
example.en: He lives on the edge of the city and has a long commute to work.

复活.gloss: to come back to life; to revive; resurrection

example.zh: 春天来了，大地仿佛复活了。
example.en: Spring has come, and the land seems to have come back to life.

example.zh: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样。
example.en: These twins look exactly alike.

example.zh: 这个小区的居民大多是退休老人。
example.en: Most of the residents in this neighbourhood are retired elderly people.

example.zh: 突然停电了，我们只好点上蜡烛。
example.en: The power suddenly went out, so we had to light candles.

example.zh: 在这个问题上，我们的立场是一致的。
example.en: On this issue, our positions are the same.

example.zh: 他用坚强的意志完成了马拉松比赛。
example.en: With strong willpower he finished the marathon.

example.zh: 我从来没有遇到过这种情形。
example.en: I've never come across this kind of situation before.

example.zh: 这位老人对每个人都很仁慈。
example.en: This old man is kind to everyone.

example.zh: 火车穿过了一条长长的隧道。
example.en: The train passed through a long tunnel.

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，他无比激动。
example.en: He was extremely excited to hear this good news.

example.zh: 这部纪录片介绍了导弹的发展历史。
example.en: This documentary introduces the history of missile development.

一向.gloss: always (up to now); all along; consistently

example.zh: 他一向很守时，今天怎么还没来？
example.en: He's always punctual; why hasn't he come yet today?

突破.gloss: to break through; to surmount; breakthrough

example.zh: 这项研究在技术上取得了重大突破。
example.en: This research has achieved a major technical breakthrough.

example.zh: 他真有本事，一个人就把问题解决了。
example.en: He's really capable; he solved the problem on his own.

example.zh: 电脑会按照我们输入的指令工作。
example.en: The computer works according to the instructions we enter.

example.zh: 这个国家的经济主要依靠石油出口。
example.en: This country's economy relies mainly on oil exports.

example.zh: 天黑了，登山队决定先撤退到山下。
example.en: It got dark, so the climbing team decided to retreat down the mountain first.

example.zh: 这本书讲述了一个孩子悲惨的童年。
example.en: This book tells of a child's miserable childhood.

example.zh: 我们需要改变传统的教学模式。
example.en: We need to change the traditional teaching model.

example.zh: 一场风暴让很多航班都取消了。
example.en: A storm caused many flights to be cancelled.

忽略.gloss: to neglect; to overlook; to ignore

example.zh: 工作再忙，也不能忽略自己的健康。
example.en: No matter how busy you are at work, you can't neglect your health.

example.zh: 我们不能只看一个人的外表。
example.en: We can't judge a person only by appearance.

example.zh: 请问这项服务需要额外付费吗？
example.en: Excuse me, does this service cost extra?

干扰.gloss: to disturb; to interfere with; interference

example.zh: 请把手机调成静音，不要干扰别人。
example.en: Please put your phone on silent and don't disturb others.

example.zh: 我们队的防守非常好，对方一个球也没进。
example.en: Our team's defence was excellent; the other side didn't score a single goal.

牵.gloss: to lead along; to pull; to hold (hands); to involve

example.zh: 他牵着狗在公园里散步。
example.en: He walked his dog on a lead in the park.

欺负.gloss: to bully; to pick on; to push around

example.zh: 大孩子不应该欺负小孩子。
example.en: Big kids shouldn't bully little kids.

挽救.gloss: to save; to rescue; to remedy

example.zh: 医生们尽力挽救病人的生命。
example.en: The doctors did their best to save the patient's life.

example.zh: 长期酗酒会严重损害肝脏。
example.en: Long-term heavy drinking can seriously damage the liver.

脱离.gloss: to break away from; to separate from; to be out of (danger)
脱离.indonesian: melepaskan diri dari; terpisah dari; lepas dari (bahaya)

example.zh: 经过抢救，病人已经脱离了危险。
example.en: After emergency treatment, the patient is out of danger.

example.zh: 大城市的生活节奏很快。
example.en: The pace of life in big cities is very fast.

example.zh: 这个枕头太高了，我睡得不舒服。
example.en: This pillow is too high; I don't sleep comfortably.

拼命.gloss: desperately; with all one's might; to risk one's life

example.zh: 为了考上大学，他每天都在拼命学习。
example.en: He studies like mad every day to get into university.

example.zh: 这台机器操作起来非常简单。
example.en: This machine is very easy to operate.

example.zh: 这部电视剧的情节很吸引人。
example.en: The plot of this TV drama is very gripping.

example.zh: 长时间看屏幕，眼睛会很累。
example.en: Looking at a screen for a long time makes your eyes tired.

example.zh: 中国大陆现在使用的是简体字。
example.en: Mainland China now uses simplified characters.

吊.gloss: to hang; to suspend; to lift (with a crane)

example.zh: 天花板上吊着一盏漂亮的灯。
example.en: A beautiful lamp hangs from the ceiling.

example.zh: 你不要过于担心，问题不大。
example.en: Don't worry too much; it's not a big problem.

呵.gloss: to breathe out (on); to scold; ha (sound of laughter)

example.zh: 天太冷了，他往手上呵了几口气。
example.en: It was so cold that he blew a few breaths onto his hands.

example.zh: 村子里的人以前都从这口井里打水。
example.en: The villagers used to draw water from this well.

访问.gloss: to visit; to call on; to interview; to access (a website)

example.zh: 这位作家下个月将访问我们学校。
example.en: This writer will visit our school next month.

example.zh: 人体是由无数个细胞组成的。
example.en: The human body is made up of countless cells.

example.zh: 他对朋友一向很慷慨。
example.en: He has always been generous to his friends.

example.zh: 这个年轻人很有发展潜力。
example.en: This young man has great potential.

example.zh: 他的这个举动让大家都很感动。
example.en: What he did moved everyone.

example.zh: 广场上有很多鸽子在找吃的。
example.en: There are many pigeons looking for food in the square.

example.zh: 邻居们抗议工厂夜里发出的噪音。
example.en: The neighbours protested about the noise the factory makes at night.

example.zh: 今天是我们结婚十周年纪念日。
example.en: Today is our tenth wedding anniversary.

example.zh: 健康是人生最大的财富。
example.en: Health is the greatest wealth in life.

example.zh: 学校对学生实行了新的奖学金政策。
example.en: The school has introduced a new scholarship policy for students.

指责.gloss: to criticize; to censure; to blame

example.zh: 出了问题不要互相指责，先想办法解决。
example.en: When problems arise, don't blame each other; first find a way to solve them.

哭泣.gloss: to weep; to cry; to sob

example.zh: 她一个人在房间里低声哭泣。
example.en: She was weeping quietly alone in her room.

example.zh: 做生意也要讲良心，不能欺骗顾客。
example.en: Business must also be done with a conscience; you can't cheat customers.

example.zh: 我侄子今年刚上小学一年级。
example.en: My nephew just started first grade this year.

容忍.gloss: to tolerate; to put up with; to condone

example.zh: 我无法容忍别人在公共场合大声打电话。
example.en: I can't stand people talking loudly on the phone in public.

example.zh: 桌子上满是面包渣，快擦一擦。
example.en: The table is covered in breadcrumbs; wipe it quickly.

清除.gloss: to clear away; to eliminate; to get rid of

example.zh: 工人们正在清除路上的积雪。
example.en: The workers are clearing the snow from the road.

example.zh: 每个人都有自己的尊严。
example.en: Everyone has their own dignity.

example.zh: 爷爷每天早上都用收音机听新闻。
example.en: Grandpa listens to the news on the radio every morning.

example.zh: 选择人生伴侣是一件很重要的事。
example.en: Choosing a life partner is a very important matter.

遭受.gloss: to suffer; to be subjected to; to sustain (a loss)

example.zh: 这个地区去年遭受了严重的洪水。
example.en: This region suffered severe flooding last year.

example.zh: 医生说他身上的肿瘤是良性的。
example.en: The doctor said his tumour is benign.

example.zh: 这次旅行的预算是五千块。
example.en: The budget for this trip is five thousand yuan.

example.zh: 厨房里飘出一股好闻的气味。
example.en: A pleasant smell drifted out of the kitchen.

发布.gloss: to release; to issue; to announce; to publish

example.zh: 这家公司明天将发布一款新手机。
example.en: This company will release a new phone tomorrow.

example.zh: 这家医院每天接待上千名患者。
example.en: This hospital receives over a thousand patients every day.

example.zh: 第一次离开家，我才知道想家是什么滋味。
example.en: Only when I left home for the first time did I know what homesickness feels like.

example.zh: 这位画家用了很独特的艺术手法。
example.en: This painter used a very distinctive artistic technique.

涉及.gloss: to involve; to relate to; to touch upon

example.zh: 这个问题涉及很多方面，需要慢慢讨论。
example.en: This issue involves many aspects and needs to be discussed slowly.

征服.gloss: to conquer; to subdue; to win over

example.zh: 他的歌声征服了所有的观众。
example.en: His singing won over the entire audience.

作弊.gloss: to cheat (in an exam); to practise fraud

example.zh: 考试作弊是绝对不允许的。
example.en: Cheating in exams is absolutely not allowed.

example.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个年轻人为父亲报仇的故事。
example.en: This film tells the story of a young man avenging his father.

浑身.gloss: all over the body; from head to toe
浑身.indonesian: seluruh tubuh; dari ujung kepala sampai kaki

example.zh: 跑完步以后，他浑身都是汗。
example.en: After running, he was sweating all over.

example.zh: 爷爷收藏了几百张老邮票。
example.en: Grandpa has collected several hundred old stamps.

布置.gloss: to arrange; to decorate; to assign (homework)

example.zh: 同学们正在布置教室，准备晚会。
example.en: The students are decorating the classroom to get ready for the party.
